sources.title: Veterinary fracture diagnosis: a deep learning model for dogs long bone ...
sources.snippet: A deep learning model based on classification of long bone fractures in dogs using medical conventional radiographic images using a convolutional neural network, specifically ResNet50 to improve detection and fracture classification and emphasizes the potential of artificial intelligence in veterinary orthopaedic.

sources.title: AI for fracture diagnosis in clinical practice: Four approaches to ...
sources.snippet: Abstract Purpose Artificial Intelligence (AI) has been shown to enhance fracture-detection-accuracy, but the most effective AI-implementation in clinical practice is less well understood. In the current study, four approaches to AI-implementation are evaluated for their impact on AI-effectiveness.

sources.title: Multi-Modal Bone Fracture Detection - GitHub
sources.snippet: Bone fractures require accurate, timely diagnosis. This project leverages the strengths of multiple deep learning architectures to automatically detect fractures from X-ray images. By implementing a YOLOv8-based model, a ResNet-based model, and a custom CNN, we provide a comprehensive comparison in performance—evaluated on metrics such as accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score.
